records.name: Target Defence Academy
records.evidence: The official Target Defence Academy site presents NDA, CDS, AFCAT and armed-forces-entry coaching with mock SSB and fitness preparation, not a recognised degree institution.

records.name: Trident Academy
records.evidence: The official Trident Academy site presents NDA, CDS and SSB preparation and residential coaching, which is private defence coaching rather than university or affiliated-college education.

records.name: SAFAL Academy
records.evidence: The official SAFAL Academy site presents NDA, CDS, AFCAT, MNS and SSB coaching programmes, not a degree-awarding institution.

records.name: Jindal Global Law School
records.statutory_basis: constituent law school of a state private university
records.evidence: The official JGLS site publishes admissions for integrated law, LL.M. and doctoral programmes and identifies the school as part of O.P. Jindal Global University, a private university.
notes: Constituent law school; parent linking can be added during cleanup.

records.name: Bennett University
records.statutory_basis: state private university established under Uttar Pradesh law
records.evidence: The official Bennett University site presents degree admissions across engineering, media, law and management as a state private university.

records.name: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act
records.evidence: The official SRMIST site presents degree admissions across engineering, medicine, law, science and management; SRM Institute of Science and Technology is a private deemed-to-be university.

records.name: IITRAM Ahmedabad
records.statutory_basis: institute established by the Government of Gujarat under state legislation
records.evidence: The official IITRAM site presents B.Tech. and M.Tech. admissions and identifies IITRAM as a Government of Gujarat institute focused on infrastructure, technology, research and management.

records.name: Vel Tech Chennai
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act
records.evidence: The official Vel Tech site presents degree admissions in engineering, technology and science; Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology is a private deemed-to-be university.

records.name: Indian Institute of Drone Technology (IIDT)
records.evidence: The official IIDT site presents drone-pilot, repair and entrepreneurship training as a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation, a regulated skill-training provider rather than a university.
notes: G9 covers regulated skill and vocational training; verify current DGCA listing during final import.

records.name: Presidency University
records.statutory_basis: private university established under Karnataka law and listed in the UGC university framework
records.evidence: The official Presidency University site presents the Bengaluru institution as a private university with undergraduate and postgraduate admissions; it is not a state or central university.

records.name: Delhi Technological University
records.evidence: DTU's official site identifies it as a statutory university of the Government of NCT of Delhi, with degree admissions in engineering and other disciplines; it therefore belongs to the state-public group.

records.name: Chandigarh University
records.evidence: The official Chandigarh University site presents it as a private university in Mohali with degree admissions across engineering, management, law, pharmacy and other domains.

records.name: National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE)
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institute under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Government of India
records.evidence: NISE's official site identifies it as the apex national institute under MNRE for solar research, testing and capacity building. Its training and research programmes make it a central-government institute, not a private college.
notes: Research/training institute; do not treat it as a conventional degree university in ranking UI.

records.name: TERI School of Advanced Studies
records.statutory_basis: deemed-to-be university under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956
records.evidence: The official TERI SAS site presents the institution as TERI School of Advanced Studies, a deemed-to-be university offering postgraduate and doctoral admissions in energy, environment and sustainability.

records.name: Garuda Aerospace RPTO
records.evidence: Garuda Aerospace's official site presents its RPTO as a DGCA-approved remote-pilot training organisation providing drone pilot training, not a degree-granting university or college.

records.name: IIT Guwahati RPTO (EduRade)
records.statutory_basis: DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation operating through IIT Guwahati/EduRade
records.evidence: The IIT Guwahati official site identifies the RPTO/training offering as drone remote-pilot training. Because this row represents the short-course RPTO rather than IIT Guwahati's degree institution, it is classified as a drone training provider.
notes: G10b is Phase 2; parent IIT Guwahati remains a separate G1 institute record.

records.name: Pavaman Aviation RPTO
records.evidence: The official Pavaman Aviation site presents the Hyderabad organisation as an RPTO delivering remote-pilot certificate training, not a degree-granting higher-education institution.

records.name: Berry Avionics RPTO
records.evidence: The official Berry Avionics site presents its Pune RPTO as a provider of small- and medium-drone remote-pilot training leading to the Remote Pilot Certificate, rather than a university or college.

records.name: DroneAcharya RPTO at IIT Ropar
records.statutory_basis: DGCA-approved RPTO operated by DroneAcharya in association with IIT Ropar
records.evidence: DroneAcharya's official site presents the IIT Ropar offering as commercial drone pilot and technology training. This specific row is the RPTO/training provider, not the IIT degree institution.
notes: G10b is Phase 2; parent IIT Ropar remains a separate G1 institute record.

records.name: MANAGE Hyderabad
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institute under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
records.evidence: The official MANAGE profile identifies it as an apex-level autonomous institute under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, and its official admissions page publishes the AICTE-recognised PGDM in Agri-Business Management.
notes: Central-government institute; no narrower seeded family currently exists.

records.name: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA)
records.statutory_basis: autonomous institution under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
records.evidence: The official IICA structure page identifies the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs as a society established to run IICA, whose governing body is headed by the Minister and Secretary of Corporate Affairs; official IICA programme pages publish education and certification admissions.
notes: Central-government capacity-building and research institute; no narrower seeded family currently exists.

records.name: TERI - The Energy and Resources Institute
records.statutory_basis: independent not-for-profit research institute; degree programmes are offered through the separate TERI School of Advanced Studies
records.evidence: TERI's official profile identifies it as an independent research organisation in energy, environment and sustainable development. The supplied record describes graduate and doctoral education through TERI School of Advanced Studies, so TERI itself is retained as a non-degree research body.
notes: Keep TERI School of Advanced Studies as the admitting academic institution if represented separately.

records.name: Indian Green Building Council (IGBC)

records.evidence: The official IGBC profile presents IGBC as the Confederation of Indian Industry's green-building council providing certification, training and advocacy; it is not a degree-admitting college.
notes: Professional certification body; keep outside the college ladder.
